title: Saving an edit after another user put a customer on the term is refused
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • You and a second user, {User-B}, are both signed in with the "Admin" role, in two separate browsers.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S3 Second Admin.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date, held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S3-26 Fourteen.
  • Customer {Customer-A} holds COD.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S3-26 Customer.
  • Starting screen: your browser shows the Credit Terms page; {User-B}'s browser shows Edit Customer for {Customer-A}.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In your browser, click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Edit".
  3. Replace 14 with 21 in the Days box.
  4. In {User-B}'s browser, set Credit Terms to {Term-A}.
  5. In {User-B}'s browser, click Save.
  6. In your browser, click "Save Changes".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: the "Edit Credit Term" window opens.
  • Step 3: the blue line shows 21 days.
  • Step 4: the dropdown shows {Term-A}.
  • Step 5: the customer is saved on {Term-A}.
  • Step 6: the app's error alert shows "Used by 1 customer. Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers." The window stays open with 21 still typed, and the row still reads 14 days.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • Story 3, Error Handling: “If Create or Save is refused by the server, the app's standard error alert shows the reason (the S3-R9 texts, or "Pick Due Net X days or Due day of the following month." when no option is sent, or "Used by {holders}. Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers." when the term became in use meanwhile). The window stays open with the user's input.”
  • Key Decisions: “Once a term is in use (by any customer, vendor or invoice), its name and days are locked; it can be deactivated but not deleted. An unused term can be edited or deleted.”
  • Out of Scope: “Renaming or changing the days of a term in use. QuickBooks cannot rename a term and invoices hold the name. To rename, deactivate the term and create a new one.”
